svg.text: Field lab / decontamination. Cream ABS, hazard yellow, signal red.
Fallout-shelter equipment. Cold steel, cream, oxblood and amber.
Scavenged and repaired. Weathered brown, bone, rust and nicotine gold.
No colour but light. Sodium vapour and cold mercury on near-black.
Clinical, unsettling. Stainless, near-black ink, one blood accent.
